rules.rule: Focus on: silent exception swallowing that hides configuration errors; concurrency correctness in asyncio.gather / create_task / cancel (must await cancelled tasks); whether the recipe tool whitelist can fail open and expose tools that should stay hidden.

Focus on: every chat tool must declare a non-empty caliber (data-provenance caveat); permission checks (requires) must be enforced before the handler runs; SQL must use parameterized queries; SessionLocal must not be used directly inside async def (blocks the event loop).
Focus on: blocking DB calls inside async def endpoints; user input reaching SQL or HTML without escaping; missing authz on state-changing endpoints; response shape drift versus the OpenAPI contract.
Focus on: correctness of numeric conversions and units; data-provenance caveats in returned conclusions; None handling on optional fields; timezone-aware datetimes.
Focus on: missing indexes on frequently filtered columns; transaction boundaries and rollback; N+1 query patterns; schema migration safety.
